name: Actor
notes:
You can adjust scopes with the following:

assign_scopes=foo,bar  # Assigns the foo & bar scopes
remove_scopes=foo      # Removes the foo scope

key.desc: The actor's unique key, derived from their identifier

uuid.desc: A public UUID for the actor

scopes.desc: A list of scopes granted to the actor

created_at.desc: The time the actor was created

updated_at.desc: The last time the actor was saved
